name: Motion
purpose: Reference-led procedural visuals and animation for social video

shared.name: Intent and attention
shared.decision: Select detail, pace and hierarchy from the message, audience and viewing context.
shared.mechanism: A single dominant event at a time can make the intended reading easier to follow.
shared.tradeoff: Excessive simplification can remove needed meaning.
shared.verification: Watch once without explanation; record what was noticed and understood.
shared.evidence: Authored operational heuristic; validate in the active project.

shared.name: Source roles and creative learning
shared.decision: When sources are supplied, distinguish learning, inspiration and explicit matching. Record the properties each source informs, observations and uncertainty. With no source, derive project decisions from intent and experiments; leave reference assignments empty.
shared.mechanism: Separating transferable relationships from source-specific appearance can expand creative choices while making requested comparisons actionable.
shared.tradeoff: Treating the latest source as a mandatory style or mistaking inferred technique for observed fact narrows creativity.
shared.verification: Check source roles against the actual request. For learning, propose a different realization of the relationship; for matching, compare only requested properties. Record what was inspected and what remains unverified.
shared.evidence: Authored operational heuristic; validate in the active project.

shared.name: Geometry and coordinates
shared.decision: Declare units, origin, axes, projection and transform order before constructing related objects.
shared.mechanism: Consistent coordinates preserve intended relationships across renderers and motion.
shared.tradeoff: Changing coordinate conventions can invert axes or alter pivots.
shared.verification: Render axis markers and test known points before final framing.
shared.evidence: Authored operational heuristic; validate in the active project.

shared.name: Perceptual hierarchy
shared.decision: Allocate contrast, scale, spacing and dwell time to the intended focal subject.
shared.mechanism: Controlled competition between elements can preserve visual hierarchy.
shared.tradeoff: Texture, highlights and movement may attract more attention than the message.
shared.verification: Inspect at phone size, in grayscale and during the busiest moment.
shared.evidence: Authored operational heuristic; validate in the active project.

shared.name: Time and continuity
shared.decision: Use explicit frame indices and a rational frame rate; define shot intervals as half-open ranges.
shared.mechanism: A common timebase prevents timing drift and duplicate boundary frames.
shared.tradeoff: Mixing milliseconds, seconds and frame indices produces offsets.
shared.verification: Evaluate frames immediately before, at and after a boundary and check duration.
shared.evidence: Authored operational heuristic; validate in the active project.

shared.name: Deterministic state
shared.decision: Make scene state a function of project parameters, exact time and seed; checkpoint any simulation.
shared.mechanism: Re-rendering a frame out of order should preserve its pixels under a fixed environment.
shared.tradeoff: Hidden clock reads, load races and global random state break replay.
shared.verification: Render the same times in a different order and compare pixels or documented tolerances.
shared.evidence: Authored operational heuristic; validate in the active project.

shared.name: Identity and continuity
shared.decision: Track object identity, correspondence, screen direction and visibility between visual states.
shared.mechanism: Preserving chosen invariants can make changes legible as one evolving object or idea.
shared.tradeoff: Smooth interpolation can still produce a semantically wrong transition.
shared.verification: Inspect silhouette, topology and identity through the entire interval.
shared.evidence: Authored operational heuristic; validate in the active project.

shared.name: Spatial and temporal sampling
shared.decision: Match feature size and motion speed to final resolution and frame rate; prefilter when needed.
shared.mechanism: Adequate sampling reduces jagged edges, shimmer and temporal aliasing.
shared.tradeoff: More samples increase render cost and blur can obscure small text.
shared.verification: Inspect fast edges and fine patterns in the encoded clip at actual playback speed.
shared.evidence: Authored operational heuristic; validate in the active project.

shared.name: Color and alpha contract
shared.decision: Declare working and output color spaces, transfer functions, alpha convention and any view transform.
shared.mechanism: Consistent conversion preserves expected appearance across compositing and delivery.
shared.tradeoff: Applying a transform twice or tagging unconverted data can alter appearance.
shared.verification: Compare known patches, gradients and transparent edges through the full pipeline.
shared.evidence: Authored operational heuristic; validate in the active project.

shared.name: Measured resource budget
shared.decision: Measure representative frames before committing to resolution, samples or simulation density.
shared.mechanism: Measured cost supports achievable rendering without guessing hardware capacity.
shared.tradeoff: A simple frame may underestimate peak complexity or memory.
shared.verification: Benchmark the most expensive expected frame and a short representative segment.
shared.evidence: Authored operational heuristic; validate in the active project.

shared.name: Observation and revision
shared.decision: Pair each decision with an expected result, a concrete check and a revision trigger.
shared.mechanism: Observable disagreements can guide useful corrections instead of arbitrary changes.
shared.tradeoff: Metrics can miss semantic meaning and visual character.
shared.verification: Record the actual observation, affected decision and chosen correction.
shared.evidence: Authored operational heuristic; validate in the active project.

shared.name: Source and dependency provenance
shared.decision: Record reference roles and origins, font files, runtime versions, seeds and external dependencies.
shared.mechanism: Known inputs make rebuilds, substitutions and asset boundaries explicit.
shared.tradeoff: An unavailable font or hidden image texture can change the result.
shared.verification: Rebuild from the recorded inputs; audit image loads and font substitutions.
shared.evidence: Authored operational heuristic; validate in the active project.

specializations.name: Creative Brief
specializations.inputs: Message, audience, duration, destination and constraints
specializations.decision: Turn the request into a visible outcome and a short list of visual priorities; retain unresolved choices explicitly.
specializations.mechanism: A bounded purpose can guide both image selection and scene construction.
specializations.tradeoff: Too many equal priorities weaken the focal message.
specializations.verification: Describe the intended takeaway in one sentence and test the planned opening against it.
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Reference Curation
specializations.inputs: Optional images, video, sound, prior output or user lessons; current intent and source access
specializations.decision: Resolve whether a source is for learning, inspiration or explicit matching. Inspect relevant intervals and label observed, inferred and invented properties. Read Creative-Learning.md when extracting a lesson. Keep original media and source-specific study records outside the main engine. If no reference is supplied, continue from the idea and project constraints.
specializations.mechanism: Role-specific source handling can preserve evidence while allowing several independent realizations of a learned relationship.
specializations.tradeoff: A single attractive example can become an accidental style requirement; contact sheets can suggest order without establishing smoothness or sound timing.
specializations.verification: Record source identity, inspected intervals, method and uncertainty. Map each proposed lesson to an existing owner, show where it may fail and distinguish source observation from a generalization.
specializations.output: Optional source-role manifest, scoped observations and transferable learning candidates
specializations.evidence: Authored craft hypothesis informed by visual study; source observations do not establish perceptual causality or validated rendering. Verify in the active project.

specializations.name: Visual Direction
specializations.inputs: Brief and role-labelled references
specializations.decision: Define a coherent visual grammar for proportions, type, palette, edge treatment, surface detail and camera; compare alternatives as stills. Select a visual language from the current message and project identity. Use learned mechanisms as optional choices; permit a new palette, medium, density and pacing. Compare alternatives only when a creative decision needs resolving. A reference or perpetual motion is not required.
specializations.mechanism: Shared visual rules can make separately built scenes feel related.
specializations.tradeoff: A rigid style rule can prevent an important scene from communicating clearly.
specializations.verification: Place representative frames side by side and inspect hierarchy and consistency.
specializations.evidence: Authored craft hypothesis informed by visual study; source observations do not establish perceptual causality or validated rendering. Verify in the active project.

specializations.name: Storyboard
specializations.inputs: Message structure and visual system
specializations.decision: Map each beat to a shot, its visible action and the reason for its transition; choose duration from reading and action needs.
specializations.mechanism: An explicit sequence can expose missing information before expensive rendering.
specializations.tradeoff: Attractive individual shots may fail to form a readable sequence.
specializations.verification: Walk through the boards without narration and identify gaps or redundant beats.
specializations.output: Shot list and provisional beat timing
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Styleframes
specializations.inputs: Shot list and reference targets
specializations.decision: Resolve key stills for appearance; include motion extremes and transition boundaries when they alter composition. For original work, develop project-owned key states from the idea. Select only the states needed to test composition and change; include a deliberate hold when it serves comprehension. Source matching is conditional on the brief.
specializations.mechanism: Defined visual endpoints make reconstruction and motion decisions reviewable.
specializations.tradeoff: Perfect endpoints do not guarantee good intermediate shapes or movement.
specializations.verification: Compare start, key event and end frames; flag properties that must remain invariant.
specializations.evidence: Authored craft hypothesis informed by visual study; source observations do not establish perceptual causality or validated rendering. Verify in the active project.

specializations.name: Shot Continuity
specializations.inputs: Adjacent styleframes and object identities
specializations.decision: Choose which identities, screen anchors, direction, scale, phrase or visual motifs should persist across a cut. Preserve the relationship serving the current idea and mark deliberate breaks. A repeated caption can link diverse footage; a new speaker or thought may require a reset. Do not force every source into identical framing or color.
specializations.mechanism: Selected continuity cues can help viewers connect changes across edits.
specializations.tradeoff: Preserving every cue may make scenes repetitive.
specializations.verification: Inspect frames around each cut, caption carryover and the intended subject/eyeline. Review the sequence at target speed before judging continuity or rhythm; sparse samples cannot establish cut quality.
specializations.evidence: Authored craft hypothesis informed by multiple visual studies; sampled frames establish visible states, not validated audience response, playback rhythm or audiovisual synchronization.

specializations.name: Shape Decomposition
specializations.inputs: Reference image, crop and focal objects
specializations.decision: Separate silhouette, internal contours, negative space and occlusion into editable primitives or meshes; prioritize large relationships.
specializations.mechanism: Reconstructing silhouette and proportion first can reduce wasted detail work.
specializations.tradeoff: Premature tracing of tiny details can preserve pixels while missing structure.
specializations.verification: Compare flat silhouette masks at matched scale before adding shading.
specializations.output: Object hierarchy, shape measurements and construction plan
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Spatial Inference
specializations.inputs: Perspective cues, overlaps and visible faces
specializations.decision: Infer a plausible camera and depth layout; record alternate explanations when one image cannot determine hidden geometry.
specializations.mechanism: Consistent perspective can reproduce visible depth with economical geometry.
specializations.tradeoff: A single image does not uniquely reveal camera, depth or hidden surfaces.
specializations.verification: Overlay projected edges and test the requested camera move for exposed gaps.
specializations.output: Camera hypothesis, depth arrangement and uncertainty notes
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Appearance Inference
specializations.inputs: Highlights, shadows, gradients and surface cues
specializations.decision: Separate likely material response from illumination and painted detail; test simple material-light combinations.
specializations.mechanism: Separating causes makes later movement and relighting more coherent.
specializations.tradeoff: A baked highlight can be mistaken for a physically moving reflection.
specializations.verification: Rotate a light or camera in a probe render and inspect whether surface cues behave plausibly.
specializations.output: Material and lighting hypotheses with confidence notes
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Reconstruction Planning
specializations.inputs: Decomposition, shot movement and hardware observations
specializations.decision: Choose vector, layered 2.5D, analytic shading or full 3D per object based on required views; define any allowed imported assets.
specializations.mechanism: Representation matched to visible behavior can reduce cost while preserving the target.
specializations.tradeoff: A shortcut may fail when motion exposes a side absent from the reference.
specializations.verification: Test the widest planned view and audit every image load against the declared procedural scope.
specializations.output: Representation plan and procedural asset boundary
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Reference Matching
specializations.inputs: Candidate output and explicitly selected comparison properties, if any
specializations.decision: Activate comparison only for an agreed target or a useful learning question. Align crop, size and event phase before diagnosing differences. Compare silhouette, layout, value, color and material independently; compare motion using start, peak action and settle rather than unrelated absolute timestamps. For original work, judge intent and the project contract instead of similarity to a source.
specializations.mechanism: Structured comparison can make revisions more attributable.
specializations.tradeoff: Pixel similarity can reward copying and penalize an intentional variation; static image agreement does not establish temporal quality.
specializations.verification: Name a meaningful discrepancy, its likely cause and the evidence after revision. Retain an intentional deviation when it serves the brief. Mark inferred velocities, unavailable playback and unreviewed audio explicitly.
specializations.evidence: Authored craft hypothesis informed by visual study; source observations do not establish perceptual causality or validated rendering. Verify in the active project.

specializations.name: Ambiguity Resolution
specializations.inputs: Unobserved regions and competing visual interpretations
specializations.decision: Mark observed, inferred and invented properties; build the simplest plausible hidden structure needed by the shot.
specializations.mechanism: Explicit uncertainty can prevent unsupported detail from dominating reconstruction.
specializations.tradeoff: Excessively literal reconstruction can block useful creative interpretation.
specializations.verification: Inspect every newly revealed region and check it against the agreed creative freedom.
specializations.output: Chosen interpretation and unresolved reference limits
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Curve Geometry
specializations.inputs: Silhouettes, handles, stroke targets and scale
specializations.decision: Construct paths with controlled tangents, joins and sampling appropriate to output scale. For animated strokes distinguish path geometry, trim interval, width profile and emission. Parameterize travel by arc length when constant visual speed is intended; parameter-space interpolation can change speed on uneven curves. Keep tail length and taper independent from glow.
specializations.mechanism: Smooth curvature and stable stroke treatment can preserve intended contours.
specializations.tradeoff: Too few samples facet curves; too many increase cost without visible benefit.
specializations.verification: Inspect inflections, corners, trim endpoints, joins and scale extremes. For moving paths inspect near-zero visible length, maximum curvature and rapid changes. Test trajectory and silhouette without glow; send time-varying controls to transform-animation and easing.
specializations.output: Reusable curve constructors and path parameters
specializations.evidence: Authored craft hypothesis informed by visual study; source observations do not establish perceptual causality or validated rendering. Verify in the active project.

specializations.name: Planar Geometry
specializations.inputs: Shape outlines, holes, overlaps and fill rules
specializations.decision: Build filled regions and negative spaces using explicit winding and boolean operations; retain separate semantic parts.
specializations.mechanism: Explicit topology can keep fills and cutouts consistent across edits.
specializations.tradeoff: Self-intersections and inconsistent winding can invert holes or create artifacts.
specializations.verification: Render flat masks and inspect holes, overlaps and extreme parameter values.
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Procedural Modeling
specializations.inputs: Required views, silhouette and object dimensions
specializations.decision: Generate meshes, sweeps, profiles and bevels from parameters; use actual volume where camera movement demands it.
specializations.mechanism: Parametric volume supports coherent changes across viewpoints.
specializations.tradeoff: Bad normals, topology or unnecessary subdivisions can degrade shading and speed.
specializations.verification: Inspect silhouette from all planned views plus normals and the closest camera distance.
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Typography
specializations.inputs: Exact copy, semantic groups, font/shaping support, intended emphasis, viewing scale and available frame area
specializations.decision: Separate complete text and phrase composition from reveal order. Measure actual glyphs and layout the intended readable state; choose line breaks, baseline anchors, hierarchy and local transforms deliberately. Stable block bounds can prevent accidental reflow as words appear; dynamic reflow is valid when explicitly designed. Protect connector words, negation, quantities, diacritics and unsupported-script handling.
specializations.mechanism: Stable text geometry supports predictable composition and animation anchors.
specializations.tradeoff: Substituted fonts or unsupported scripts can invalidate measured layout.
specializations.verification: Render actual copy and fonts at output size; inspect line breaks, first/last glyphs, descenders, diacritics, spacing and maximum animated bounds. Check both final phrase and intermediate reveals. A font or translation change invalidates measured layout.
specializations.output: Measured text and phrase layout, semantic emphasis spans, anchors and font manifest
specializations.evidence: Authored craft hypothesis informed by multiple visual studies; sampled frames establish visible states, not validated audience response, playback rhythm or audiovisual synchronization.

specializations.name: Composition
specializations.inputs: Subject hierarchy, frame ratio and projected bounds
specializations.decision: Balance focal weight, alignment, negative space and grouping; evaluate composition at motion extremes as well as stills. Separate output frame, any inset footage window and the text block. Stage captions around important face/gesture/action regions or intentional negative space. Baked borders are a source design choice, not verified platform clearance. Recompute protected regions through reframing rather than shrinking the entire scene.
specializations.mechanism: A controlled hierarchy can keep the message visible while objects change.
specializations.tradeoff: A balanced still can become crowded during movement.
specializations.verification: Inspect silhouettes and text bounds at the busiest and most expanded states.
specializations.evidence: Authored craft hypothesis informed by multiple visual studies; sampled frames establish visible states, not validated audience response, playback rhythm or audiovisual synchronization.

specializations.name: Depth Layering
specializations.inputs: Scene layers, intended depth and camera movement
specializations.decision: Assign depth, overlap and parallax deliberately; preserve ordering and reveal regions during camera moves.
specializations.mechanism: Relative displacement and occlusion can suggest volume without full geometry.
specializations.tradeoff: Flat cards may reveal edges or contradictory occlusions.
specializations.verification: Preview maximum parallax and all layer crossings.
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Color Design
specializations.inputs: Visual direction, background and material palette
specializations.decision: Define palette roles, value hierarchy, contrast and interpolation space. Coordinate footage and graphics while keeping source correction, creative look and output conversion distinct. Choose accent colors by current meaning and project identity; support associations through shape, position or type when color alone is insufficient. Keep exact palette and look values local.
specializations.mechanism: Controlled value and chromatic contrast can support visual hierarchy.
specializations.tradeoff: An appealing palette can lose separation under shading or encoding.
specializations.verification: Inspect grayscale separation, gradients, key colors and moving text/background contrast in the actual encoded result. Protect meaningful skin/product detail. Source appearance does not identify a specific LUT, camera profile or numerical grade.
specializations.evidence: Authored craft hypothesis informed by multiple visual studies; sampled frames establish visible states, not validated audience response, playback rhythm or audiovisual synchronization.

specializations.name: Materials
specializations.inputs: Surface hypothesis, geometry and lighting
specializations.decision: Encode roughness, opacity, reflectance and other needed surface properties using the selected renderer; keep stylization explicit.
specializations.mechanism: Material-light interaction can preserve surface identity through motion.
specializations.tradeoff: Physically detailed materials may be expensive or visually inappropriate.
specializations.verification: Render the material on the actual object from planned viewpoints and light angles.
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Procedural Texture
specializations.inputs: Surface scale, texture role and viewing distance
specializations.decision: Build patterns from coordinates, noise and functions with fixed seeds; choose object or world mapping to fit intended behavior.
specializations.mechanism: Procedural patterns can retain editability and avoid dependence on reference image pixels.
specializations.tradeoff: High-frequency patterns shimmer or slide if mapping is inconsistent.
specializations.verification: Inspect animated closeups and distant views for swimming and aliasing.
specializations.output: Seeded texture functions and scale settings
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Lighting
specializations.inputs: Surface response, depth cues and reference light direction
specializations.decision: Construct key, fill, rim or environment contributions as needed; separate shape-defining light from decorative highlights.
specializations.mechanism: Deliberate light placement can reveal volume and guide attention.
specializations.tradeoff: Too much fill flattens form; bright accents can compete with text.
specializations.verification: Inspect silhouette, shadow direction and highlight clipping through object rotation.
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Camera Projection
specializations.inputs: Reference framing, perspective and reveal requirements
specializations.decision: Select orthographic or perspective projection; set framing, lens or scale, near/far limits and target explicitly.
specializations.mechanism: A consistent camera aligns geometry with reference proportions.
specializations.tradeoff: Lens changes alter shape appearance and projected motion.
specializations.verification: Compare reference landmarks and inspect near-plane clipping at every planned pose.
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Compositing
specializations.inputs: Layer outputs, masks, alpha and effect intent
specializations.decision: Declare layer order, alpha convention and color space. Separate a readable structural core from adjustable broad glow, local highlights and directional or defocus blur. Keep optical effects independent of geometry and text layout. Composite in a renderer-supported working space; record the actual implementation instead of inferring a proprietary tool from appearance.
specializations.mechanism: Controlled compositing can integrate elements while preserving editability.
specializations.tradeoff: Premultiplication errors create fringes; excess glow hides structure.
specializations.verification: Compare effects enabled/disabled, text at delivery size, transparent edges on dark/light backgrounds and bright overlaps. Inspect whether clipping, bloom or blur erases content. Tune structure before increasing effect strength; technical encoding alone does not validate appearance.
specializations.evidence: Authored craft hypothesis informed by visual study; source observations do not establish perceptual causality or validated rendering. Verify in the active project.

specializations.name: Timeline Design
specializations.inputs: Shot beats, frame rate and duration
specializations.decision: Represent shots with exact frame ranges and evaluate local time from the global frame; define boundary ownership.
specializations.mechanism: Explicit scheduling can avoid accidental overlaps and gaps.
specializations.tradeoff: Floating rounding and inclusive endpoints can duplicate or omit frames.
specializations.verification: Evaluate the first, last and adjacent boundary frames and sum shot lengths.
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Timing and Pacing
specializations.inputs: Reading needs, action intent and beat structure
specializations.decision: Allocate anticipation, action, settle and reading holds from the message. Identify the primary event and offset supporting actions where the audience needs to follow a dependency. Allow anticipation or recovery to overlap the adjacent event when identity remains clear. Use beats as optional structure; neither constant movement nor a fixed duration is universal.
specializations.mechanism: Time allocated to comprehension can make a short sequence feel intentional.
specializations.tradeoff: Uniform pacing can feel mechanical; excessive speed can hide the message.
specializations.verification: Review target-speed playback for the intended takeaway, missed actions, reading time and unresolved transitions. Inspect boundary frames for continuity. Change the smallest relevant delay or duration; a contact sheet alone leaves pacing unverified.
specializations.evidence: Authored craft hypothesis informed by visual study; source observations do not establish perceptual causality or validated rendering. Verify in the active project.

specializations.name: Easing
specializations.inputs: Property endpoints and desired velocity behavior
specializations.decision: Choose interpolation for each property from intended weight, precision and energy. Separate travel from settle; coordinate positional velocity with scale and rotation. Use normalized local time, explicit endpoints and pivots. A cubic Bezier, analytic spring or deliberate hard cut is a candidate, not a default. Reuse the secondary-motion owner for physical response instead of adding competing springs.
specializations.mechanism: Appropriate velocity change can suggest weight, precision or softness.
specializations.tradeoff: Applying the same easing everywhere can create synchronized artificial motion.
specializations.verification: Sample or plot position, velocity and overshoot extrema, then inspect the result in context. Check travel-to-settle joins, bounds and the next action. Preserve a desired discontinuity only when deliberate; do not infer an exact curve from sparse source frames.
specializations.evidence: Authored craft hypothesis informed by visual study; source observations do not establish perceptual causality or validated rendering. Verify in the active project.

specializations.name: Transform Animation
specializations.inputs: Object hierarchy, pivots, trajectories and scale
specializations.decision: Animate position, rotation and scale with explicit local/world spaces; choose rotation interpolation suited to the path.
specializations.mechanism: Correct pivots and spaces preserve intended spatial relationships.
specializations.tradeoff: Euler wrapping, parent scaling or a misplaced pivot can distort motion.
specializations.verification: Inspect hierarchy transforms, rotation crossings and object bounds at extrema.
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Shape Morphing
specializations.inputs: Source and destination shapes and semantic identity
specializations.decision: Establish point or topology correspondence; interpolate meaningful structure and inspect intermediate silhouettes.
specializations.mechanism: Consistent correspondence can make transformation readable as one evolving object.
specializations.tradeoff: Arbitrary vertex matching creates folds, inversion or identity loss.
specializations.verification: Render multiple intermediate states including maximum deformation and check winding or normals.
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Secondary Motion
specializations.inputs: Main action, attachment points and desired follow-through
specializations.decision: Derive lag, spring response or overshoot from the primary action; use analytic solutions or reproducible simulation checkpoints. Assign one primary driver, attachment/pivot and lag relationship to each dependent part. Remove redundant bounce when precision or stillness better serves the object. Keep damping and initial conditions explicit.
specializations.mechanism: Delayed response can suggest elasticity and connected mass.
specializations.tradeoff: Unbounded oscillation or stateful stepping breaks stability and seeking.
specializations.verification: Test rest, impulse, large time jumps and out-of-order frame access. Also inspect the point where a new action interrupts settling; preserve continuity unless the cut is intentional.
specializations.evidence: Authored craft hypothesis informed by visual study; source observations do not establish perceptual causality or validated rendering. Verify in the active project.

specializations.name: Constraints and Rigging
specializations.inputs: Object relationships, joints and permitted motion
specializations.decision: Express attachment, look-at, distance or hierarchy constraints with explicit ownership and solve order.
specializations.mechanism: Relationship constraints can preserve coordinated behavior during revisions.
specializations.tradeoff: Cyclic dependencies and competing constraints cause jitter or unsolved states.
specializations.verification: Stress the allowed motion range and inspect constraint errors.
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Particle Systems
specializations.inputs: Emitter behavior, lifetime, distribution and scene budget
specializations.decision: Derive particles from seed, birth time and stable identity; cap density by visible need and measured resources.
specializations.mechanism: Deterministic particles permit consistent seeking and re-rendering.
specializations.tradeoff: Excess density obscures the subject and raises render or memory cost.
specializations.verification: Compare repeated frames, birth/death boundaries and peak density.
specializations.output: Seeded particle model and lifetime rules
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Camera Motion
specializations.inputs: Shot purpose, camera projection and subject trajectory
specializations.decision: Design camera position and aim together; preserve readable screen-space relationships and reveal only constructed regions.
specializations.mechanism: Purposeful framing changes can disclose depth and direct attention.
specializations.tradeoff: Camera movement can amplify apparent speed or expose incomplete reconstruction.
specializations.verification: Preview maximum reveal, angular changes and subject framing at target playback speed.
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Transitions
specializations.inputs: Adjacent scene meanings, identities and cut boundaries
specializations.decision: Choose a cut, mask, match or transformation from the relationship between adjacent ideas. Declare what is preserved: identity, screen position, direction, color correspondence or a semantic handoff. Coordinate both endpoints and any overlap. A visible cut may be clearer than continuous interpolation. Do not claim two shapes morph when the observed construction only suggests a cut or occlusion.
specializations.mechanism: A transition linked to content can connect ideas while maintaining momentum.
specializations.tradeoff: Decorative transitions can obscure meaning and create boundary artifacts.
specializations.verification: Inspect just before, at and after the boundary and intermediate extremes. Review the transition alone and in context, following the intended focal element. Confirm that the incoming information is readable after the handoff and that blur does not hide a continuity error.
specializations.evidence: Authored craft hypothesis informed by visual study; source observations do not establish perceptual causality or validated rendering. Verify in the active project.

specializations.name: Editing Rhythm
specializations.inputs: Shot lengths, visual density and message structure
specializations.decision: Place cuts, holds and visual density changes around information, gesture, reaction, contrast or resolution. Contrast a sustained performance with a meaningful insert when useful; reserve rapid montage or text-only intervals for their intended role. A beat grid, fixed cut frequency and constant movement are optional choices rather than quality rules.
specializations.mechanism: Deliberate temporal grouping can clarify sequence structure.
specializations.tradeoff: Cutting only to a fixed beat can interrupt reading or action completion.
specializations.verification: Review actual playback with and without sound; identify missed meaning, interrupted gesture, premature caption exit and redundant inserts. Distinguish observed visual order from inferred pacing when only frames were inspected.
specializations.evidence: Authored craft hypothesis informed by multiple visual studies; sampled frames establish visible states, not validated audience response, playback rhythm or audiovisual synchronization.

specializations.name: Sound Design
specializations.inputs: Intended mood, visible events and available audio sources
specializations.decision: Assign sound roles to events, atmosphere and emphasis; record imported audio provenance separately from procedural visuals.
specializations.mechanism: Controlled sound can reinforce event identity and perceived motion.
specializations.tradeoff: Excess effects or loudness differences distract from the visual subject.
specializations.verification: Listen on ordinary speakers and compare transitions, peaks and silence.
specializations.output: Audio layers, sources and level plan
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Audio Synchronization
specializations.inputs: Audio sample rate, event times and frame timeline
specializations.decision: Use a common rational timebase and explicit offsets; align cues to chosen visual events and preserve audio tails.
specializations.mechanism: Explicit mapping reduces accumulated audiovisual drift.
specializations.tradeoff: Retiming video without retiming cues or truncating tails breaks synchronization.
specializations.verification: Check early and late cues and the last audible sample in the encoded output.
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Captions and Overlays
specializations.inputs: Final copy, speech timing and viewing context
specializations.decision: Preserve exact intended language, role and timing evidence. Distinguish a complete caption from a title, keyword emphasis or illustrative label; keep a full caption track/variant when required. Place the group in a legible region using actual protected bounds, and preserve or deliberately reset its anchor across shot changes. Use Expressive-Text.md for compositional phrases.
specializations.mechanism: Readable synchronized text can preserve meaning with sound off.
specializations.tradeoff: Dense text, short holds or platform overlays can hide content.
specializations.verification: Inspect text coverage, speaker changes, legibility over changing backgrounds, intermediate bounds and placement UI. Compare claimed speech cues with actual audio; authored visual timing must remain labeled. Do not mistake selected keywords for a verified complete transcript.
specializations.evidence: Authored craft hypothesis informed by multiple visual studies; sampled frames establish visible states, not validated audience response, playback rhythm or audiovisual synchronization.

specializations.name: Scene State
specializations.inputs: Visual constructors, motion evaluators and project parameters
specializations.decision: Separate build(parameters), state_at(frame) and render(state); keep stable IDs and explicit dependencies.
specializations.mechanism: Separation enables reconstruction edits without entangling time evaluation.
specializations.tradeoff: Hidden mutations make previews depend on the order frames were visited.
specializations.verification: Evaluate the same frame before and after distant seeks and compare output.
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Procedural Randomness
specializations.inputs: Variation purpose, object IDs and seed
specializations.decision: Derive variation from explicit seeds and stable identities; separate static variation from time-varying noise.
specializations.mechanism: Stable variation can retain visual identity while allowing controlled complexity.
specializations.tradeoff: Global randomness changes unrelated objects after a small edit.
specializations.verification: Reorder object creation and verify unchanged object properties remain stable.
specializations.output: Seed strategy and deterministic noise inputs
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Reproducible Build
specializations.inputs: Scene code, fonts, dependency versions and configuration
specializations.decision: Record runtime versions, inputs and render settings; resolve assets before capture and retain build metadata.
specializations.mechanism: Known inputs support repeatable output and attributable differences.
specializations.tradeoff: Floating dependencies, unavailable assets or hardware differences can change pixels.
specializations.verification: Rebuild in a fresh output folder and compare declared invariants with tolerances.
specializations.output: Build manifest and dependency lock strategy
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Renderer Selection
specializations.inputs: Representation requirements, effects and observed runtime capabilities
specializations.decision: Choose an available renderer by required behavior and measured probe output; permit mixed renderers with explicit handoffs.
specializations.mechanism: A fit renderer can meet the visual target without unnecessary resource cost.
specializations.tradeoff: Installed binaries do not prove usable GPU contexts, fonts or codecs.
specializations.verification: Render and encode a representative probe using the actual intended execution path.
specializations.output: Renderer decision and verified capability notes
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Resource Budget
specializations.inputs: Probe frame timings, peak memory and output size
specializations.decision: Estimate frame count and cost from representative and worst-case samples; cap concurrency and preserve completed frames.
specializations.mechanism: Measured limits support workable resolution and effect choices.
specializations.tradeoff: Extrapolation can miss transient simulation or memory peaks.
specializations.verification: Render a short segment with peak complexity and compare actual cost to the estimate.
specializations.output: Resource estimate and quality fallback choices
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Execution Adapter
specializations.inputs: Available local, chat or remote execution tools
specializations.decision: Bind project commands to verified tools; report absent capabilities and checkpoint frame ranges rather than inventing a service.
specializations.mechanism: Clear execution boundaries keep instructions portable across environments.
specializations.tradeoff: A knowledge plugin does not itself supply a renderer, GPU or persistent job queue.
specializations.verification: Run one real build-render-encode path and record which steps actually completed.
specializations.output: Execution commands, locations and honest capability status
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Frame Rendering
specializations.inputs: Exact timeline, renderer and output configuration
specializations.decision: Render numbered lossless frames with explicit dimensions and frame range; resume only frames belonging to the same build signature.
specializations.mechanism: Stable frame files allow recovery and targeted revision.
specializations.tradeoff: Stale frames from older scene settings can silently contaminate output.
specializations.verification: Validate complete numbering, dimensions, signature and representative decoded pixels.
specializations.output: Complete frame sequence and render manifest
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Temporal Sampling
specializations.inputs: Motion speed, frame rate and shutter intent
specializations.decision: Sample time consistently; add subframe integration or motion blur only when it improves the target appearance. Distinguish movement-integrated motion blur from deliberate defocus and glow. Keep critical reading intervals legible and measure the cost of the busiest interval before selecting subframe count.
specializations.mechanism: Sufficient temporal sampling can reduce strobing in fast motion.
specializations.tradeoff: Blur can erase detail and subframes multiply render cost.
specializations.verification: Compare fast edges, fine patterns and readable text in encoded playback.
specializations.evidence: Authored craft hypothesis informed by visual study; source observations do not establish perceptual causality or validated rendering. Verify in the active project.

specializations.name: Color Pipeline
specializations.inputs: Working-space frames, alpha and delivery target
specializations.decision: Convert pixel values and tag output consistently; choose a documented SDR path unless another target is required.
specializations.mechanism: Explicit conversion can reduce differences between stills and video playback.
specializations.tradeoff: Metadata tags alone do not perform a color conversion.
specializations.verification: Decode the MP4 and compare patches and gradients with source frames under the same viewing transform.
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Video Encoding
specializations.inputs: Verified frames, frame rate, audio and target format
specializations.decision: Select an available codec and pixel format; set input frame rate explicitly, preserve dimensions and inspect output streams.
specializations.mechanism: Correct encoding settings preserve intended duration and playback compatibility.
specializations.tradeoff: Compression can damage thin lines, grain and gradients; audio lengths may differ.
specializations.verification: Probe dimensions, frame count, frame rate and audio duration; fully decode the output.
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Delivery Package
specializations.inputs: Validated video, editable source and intended audience
specializations.decision: Provide the requested video and rebuild inputs; confirm aspect ratio and platform requirements when publication depends on them.
specializations.mechanism: Clear deliverables support reuse and future edits.
specializations.tradeoff: Platform interface clearance and upload rules can change.
specializations.verification: Open the final file, inspect first and last frames and confirm the requested deliverable set.
specializations.output: Final video, source entry point and handoff notes
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Still Evaluation
specializations.inputs: Rendered styleframes and agreed references
specializations.decision: Compare silhouette, composition, hierarchy, color and surface behavior separately; rank deviations by visual consequence.
specializations.mechanism: Separating dimensions of appearance can make fixes more precise.
specializations.tradeoff: Numeric similarity alone cannot establish artistic or semantic success.
specializations.verification: Produce matched comparisons and describe each significant visible mismatch.
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Motion Evaluation
specializations.inputs: Representative playback, extrema and transition frames
specializations.decision: Judge timing, velocity, identity, collisions, continuity and camera behavior against the intended effect. When a source comparison is requested, align equivalent event phases and compare relationships as well as silhouettes. Use actual playback for smoothness and pacing; use dense frame inspection to localize failures.
specializations.mechanism: Temporal review can reveal failures invisible in isolated frames.
specializations.tradeoff: A contact sheet cannot establish smoothness or correct audiovisual timing.
specializations.verification: Watch the encoded clip at target speed and inspect suspect intervals frame by frame. Record the focal event, missed meaning and exact affected range. With only sampled frames, report visual states/order and keep smoothness, perceived pacing and audiovisual sync unverified. For expressive captions inspect readable-state duration, blur/scale extremes, phrase anchors and semantic carryover across cuts. Distinguish a visual subtitle reveal from verified speech synchronization.
specializations.evidence: Authored craft hypothesis informed by multiple visual studies; sampled frames establish visible states, not validated audience response, playback rhythm or audiovisual synchronization.

specializations.name: Mobile Legibility
specializations.inputs: Encoded video, small viewing size and interface clearance
specializations.decision: Inspect text, contrast, fine detail and focal subject at plausible phone display size; use project-specific safe regions.
specializations.mechanism: Small-size review can reveal losses hidden by a large preview.
specializations.tradeoff: Fixed universal safe-area claims can fail on different app layouts.
specializations.verification: View a reduced playback and simulated interface mask; record hidden or unreadable content.
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Change Impact
specializations.inputs: Requested revision, ownership graph and existing evidence
specializations.decision: Trace incoming prerequisites and outgoing conditional handoffs; invalidate affected caches, frames and downstream checks.
specializations.mechanism: Scoped propagation can preserve consistency without rebuilding unrelated work.
specializations.tradeoff: Treating every related subject as a dependency produces unnecessary rework.
specializations.verification: Revise one parameter and verify the affected owners, outputs and validation records change together.
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.

specializations.name: Quality Gates
specializations.inputs: Acceptance criteria and observed output evidence
specializations.decision: Evaluate visual fidelity, motion, technical output and procedural provenance separately; report passed, failed or unverified status.
specializations.mechanism: Separate gates prevent a technically valid file from being mistaken for a finished design.
specializations.tradeoff: Completion claims can exceed actual inspected frames or runtime capabilities.
specializations.verification: Check the delivered source and MP4 against each explicit criterion; retain unresolved observations.
specializations.evidence: Design mechanism: operational hypothesis, not a universal aesthetic law.
